title: Hiker and Skeleton Abyss
description: A lone hiker with a red backpack stands on a rocky cliff edge holding a walking stick, overlooking a field of purple flowers. Below, a burning skeleton emerges from a swirling vortex of orange and red flames, reaching upward toward a large transparent bubble containing five colorful overlapping faces in purple, green, pink, and yellow.
prompt: A surreal scene of a hiker with red backpack and walking stick standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, looking down at a fiery swirling vortex of flames from which a black skeleton is emerging and reaching out, above them floats a large transparent bubble containing five overlapping colorful stylized faces in purple green pink and yellow, vast field of purple flowers in the background, dramatic contrast between the living and the dead, dark moody atmosphere
